name: package-credit
description: One paid package of entries (ingressi): after a payment the customer holds N entries, and every appointment that happened scales one off the balance the commercial package-credits capability reads from the appointment rows. One row per grant, immutable except for nothing: a grant exists only through the commercial package-credits capability, idempotent by source key, and no client can create, forge or rewrite one. The customer is an opaque subject envelope pointing at the host contact or company record — no customer table is created here. The entry count bought is resolved by the selling path from the commercial listino product and stored as agreed, so a later listino change never rewrites a granted package.
